description: Surfaced by the fz-go4.18.23 audit (2026-07-02): fixture_matrix has ~27 pre-existing failures at BOTH 014aa505f and its parent on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership (byte-identical outputs at both commits — NOT caused by the recent .18.x work, but the lib-only gate means matrix state hasn't been part of recent evidence). Buckets: (1) stale append oracle — reductions_remaining 3997 vs expected 3998 (oracle needs re-blessing or a real off-by-one found); (2) actor_ring interp 'no settled callable entry'; (3) reusable-cons stat asserts; (4) a 3s-timeout family; (5) enum_take_drop_split / enum_predicate_search AOT builds grinding 15-18+ min CPU (the fz-f98.14 convergence-runaway family — route those there). Needs triage: which are stale oracles vs real regressions vs the known convergence bug; per project memory the matrix oracle was last restored via a legacy runtime snapshot (fz-rh2.16.6.1, dies with the old world).

comments.text: CORRELATION (fz-go4.18.22 diagnosis, 2026-07-02): the matrix redness on this machine IS (near-totally) the oscillation family. Census with a per-key value-history detector: 215 cycling re-productions across the matrix sweep, 100% RuntimeDemand keys, 9 fixtures — enum_predicate_search(84), fz_f98_range_reduce_scalar(48), opaque_fn_value_join(26), map_enumerable(20), enum_map_family(10), tailcall_closure_captures(9), repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2(6), range_enumerable(6), native_tuple_accumulator_tail(6) — overlap with the ~22 drifting matrix failures near-total. Also proven: the cycling fixtures' PRODUCTS are not schedule-deterministic (3-run fingerprint diffs on the Enum.reduce/reverse cone), i.e. the stale-oracle failures (3934 vs 3906 reduction pins etc.) are plausibly the compiler shipping schedule-dependent products, NOT stale goldens. TRIAGE THIS TICKET AFTER fz-go4.18.22's fix lands — most of it should collapse; whatever remains is genuinely stale oracles / the AOT-grind family.

F2 EVIDENCE (from the fz-go4.18.22 rework): fixtures2/behavior/repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2 is NOT a deterministic moved miscompile — it is a pre-existing SCHEDULE-DEPENDENT one, unchanged by 18.22 and by its F1 rework. 10-run interp distributions: parent f92375bc6 = 8x'10,10' / 2x'2,2'; 0810fcb89 = 6x'10,10' / 4x'2,2'; F1-fixed = both shapes too. Expected '10,2'; both wrong shapes print ONE closure-call's result for BOTH dbg callsites (reduce reducer vs count predicate conflated at a callable seam; which side wins is a coin flip). The backend program differs on EVERY run of the SAME build (4 runs -> 4 distinct dumps: generated FunctionIds 161/162 swap, transport position orderings churn) — fz-go4.18.21's schedule-dependent arrow keying territory. The JIT path fails identically and deterministically on all three commits: 'codegen: native callable value Var(3) has no settled callable boundary' (fz-f98.14 family). RuntimeDemand itself is clean on this fixture on both 0810fcb89 and the rework: 3 productions, 0 identical re-productions, and the rework's stale-caller re-settle loop never fires on it — the residual is downstream of demand.
